captions.detailed: A dark, streamlined promotional blimp featuring a large, elongated envelope with a glowing orange and blue digital sign grid on its side. Below the main body is a short, light-colored gondola with vectoring engine pylons on each side, and a cruciform tail assembly at the rear with vertical and horizontal control surfaces. Two side-mounted propeller nacelles are securely bracketed to the midsection of the hull, featuring rotating propellers for propulsion.
captions.instruction: Generate a detailed 3D blimp with an elongated envelope, a lower gondola, side-mounted propeller nacelles, and a cruciform tail assembly. Ensure the side propellers can rotate continuously on their shafts, the engine pods can rotate on short pivots, and the rudder and elevator surfaces are articulated.
captions.factory: The code constructs the blimp using an elongated hull profile via a loft or revolved spline, combined with a boolean-subtracted or patterned side grid for the glowing sign. The gondola is extruded from a base sketch and positioned underneath. The tail fins and control surfaces are built using thin box primitives, attached with revolute joints for the rudders and elevators. The side propeller nacelles and vectoring engine pods are constructed with cylinders and connected via continuous and revolute joints to represent propeller rotation and vectoring pivots.
